global.howTitle: How is the global data calculated? (monthly metric)
global.idleHoursDesc: The sum of all lost time (without classes) projected to 1 month (4 weeks). We map the daily "slots" that stay empty for more than 60 minutes, convert them into 40-minute blocks and multiply by the whole month. Pure math so the CEO knows exactly how many hours of revenue are going down the drain.
global.biggestDesc: The ranking of gyms "leaking" the most revenue. The system scans the 16 daily operating hours (6 am to 10 pm, Mon–Fri) and totals the missed opportunities in the month. We show the open wound as "monthly empty slots" for each unit.
global.optimizedDesc: The network's elite units. These gyms have zero gaps in the schedule throughout the 16-hour operating window. The ranking lists who is 100% optimized, led by whoever delivers the highest absolute number of classes in the month.
global.optimizedSub: With high volume and a full monthly schedule

performance.howTitle: How is the performance data calculated? (monthly metric)
performance.occDesc: The real attendance of classes, matching presence against the unit's floor plan. We divide the average number of students present by the maximum room capacity.
performance.occFormula: Capacity = (Actual area registered for the unit) ÷ (m² required by the modality). If the area is not provided, the system flags an error to avoid false data.
performance.vacDesc: The exact percentage of "empty slots" during the gym's operating hours over the whole month (4 weeks).
performance.vacFormula: 1 working month = 20 days of 16 hours = 320 hours or 480 possible class blocks. The rate shows how much of that is idle.
performance.diagDesc: The red alert fires when the unit is overcrowded in the few classes it has (occupancy > 70%), but the gym still sits empty much of the time (monthly vacancy > 30%).
performance.diagAction: CEO action: require new classes to be opened immediately in idle slots to relieve full rooms and increase revenue.
